name: openscad: kernel and the OpenSCAD engine load
openscad: a .scad program opens as a part with an OpenSCAD feature; the body is the plate minus the hole and the engraving
openscad: editing the feature shows the Customizer (tabs Plate and Hole, Hidden left out), the code and the echo output
openscad: a Customizer value (width 60) rebuilds the preview; OK keeps it as an override
openscad: the drop-down and Back to the defaults
openscad: the code edited in place (a sphere) becomes the body; an error shows in the output and the rebuild message
openscad: Ctrl+Enter applies the code; Tab indents (the real keys go through the code field)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const { rep } = await import('/src/cad/kernel.js'); const vol = (p) => { const b = m.actions.buildPart(p ?? m.active()).body; return b ? rep().measureVolume(b) : 0; }; const feat = () => m.active()?.features?.find((f) => f.type === 'openscad'); const editIt = async () => { const f = feat(); m.state.selection = [{ kind: 'feat', id: f.id, key: 'feat:' + f.id }]; await m.run('editFeature'); await sleep(500); }; const setField = (el, v) => { el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; await editIt(); const ta = document.querySelector('textarea[data-scad-source]'); ta.focus(); ta.value = 'cube(7);'; ta.setSelectionRange(0, 0); window.__ta = true; return 'ok'; })()

name: openscad: a 2D program comes in as a sketch on the Top plane
openscad: Export OpenSCAD writes polyhedra that open back to the same solid
openscad: Insert › OpenSCAD feature starts with a parametric plate; OK adds its body

(async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const { rep } = await import('/src/cad/kernel.js'); const vol = (p) => { const b = m.actions.buildPart(p ?? m.active()).body; return b ? rep().measureVolume(b) : 0; }; const feat = () => m.active()?.features?.find((f) => f.type === 'openscad'); const editIt = async () => { const f = feat(); m.state.selection = [{ kind: 'feat', id: f.id, key: 'feat:' + f.id }]; await m.run('editFeature'); await sleep(500); }; const setField = (el, v) => { el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; const native = await import('/src/platform/native.js');
